source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        vals = [v for v in row if v != row[0]]
        if vals:
            # A colored horizontal segment ending just before the right edge marks its endpoint.
            c = next((i for i, v in enumerate(row) if v != row[0]), None)
            if c is not None and row[c] != row[0]:
                pass
            # Find a non-background run whose right edge is followed by background at the border.
            j = len(row) - 1
            while j >= 0 and row[j] == row[0]: j -= 1
            if j >= 0 and j < len(row)-1 and all(v == row[j] for v in row[:j+1]):
                out[r][j+1] = 1
    return out
'''
